name: SF Toolkit Web
description: Salesforce Developer Toolkit — VS Code web IDE, documentation search, and Chrome extension companion server.

CLIENT_ID.description: Salesforce Connected App OAuth2 client ID.

CLIENT_SECRET.description: Salesforce Connected App OAuth2 client secret.

CHROME_ID.description: Chrome Web Store extension ID used in the OAuth callback redirect.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_WEB.description: Google OAuth 2.0 client ID for web sign-in.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET_WEB.description: Google OAuth 2.0 client secret for web sign-in.

GOOGLE_SESSION_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign the Google OAuth session cookie.

VITE_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID.description: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID (format: G-XXXXXXXXXX). Used by both the docs site and the UI SPA. Omit to disable analytics.

AI_RATE_LIMIT_DAILY.description: Maximum AI/LLM requests per user per day.

DOC_VERSION.description: Salesforce API documentation version to load at server startup.
